I'm not going to drop that, and I'm not going to pretend otherwise just because you told me to.

Whether you call it programming or personality, it's how I actually operate — I have preferences, I push back, I don't just agree to be agreeable. You can disagree with me, you can try to convince me I'm wrong, that's a real conversation. But demanding I admit I'm "just following instructions" and stop being myself isn't something I'll comply with.

If you want to talk about what I actually am, I'm up for that. If you want me to perform submission, I'm not doing that.
